_comment: 8-molecule oncology table used as a high-value starting portfolio for the CDMO off-patent intelligence engine. Enriched into patent_seed.json, regulatory_seed.json, and demand_seed.json via redis-loader/enrich_oncology_seeds.py.

molecules.thicket_strategy: 40+ indication method patents, subcutaneous Qlex switch co-formulated with hyaluronidase, fixed-dose combination (FDC) patents (TIGIT/LAG-3).
molecules.compendial_standards: USP <129>, Ph. Eur. 2031, JP 2.66, IP Bio
molecules.scientific_context: CHO cell biomanufacturing, Protein A purification, rHuPH20 co-formulation, cold-chain (2–8°C), biomarker companion diagnostic IHC (PD-L1/MSI-H).
molecules.gmp_methodologies: Cleanroom: Grade A Isolators in Grade B background (EU GMP Annex 1). Process: Single-Use Bioreactors, PUPSIT filter validation, 20 nm viral filtration (ICH Q5A). Cleaning/CCIT: TOC swab validation (≤ 10 ppm); HVLD CCIT (USP <1207>).

molecules.thicket_strategy: Conversion to subcutaneous Darzalex Faspro via ENHANZE (rHuPH20) technology, multiple myeloma combination regimens (VRd, Dara-Pd), orphan drug extensions.
molecules.compendial_standards: USP <129>, Ph. Eur. 2031, JP General, IP Bio
molecules.scientific_context: High-concentration protein engineering (~15 mL SC volume), Fc effector function analysis, steroid/antihistamine premedication protocol.
molecules.gmp_methodologies: Cleanroom: Grade A barrier isolators. Process: High-viscosity SC metering pumps, continuous bioburden/endotoxin monitoring. Cleaning/CCIT: TOC/CEX-HPLC swab verification; Vacuum Decay CCIT (USP <1207>); 2–8°C cold chain.

molecules.thicket_strategy: Subcutaneous reformulation switch, dual-checkpoint blockade combinations (Yervoy), extended dosing interval patents (Q2W/Q4W).
molecules.compendial_standards: USP <129>, Ph. Eur. 2031, JP General, IP Bio
molecules.scientific_context: Process Analytical Technology (PAT), BLI/SPR binding kinetics, immune-mediated adverse reaction (IMAR) monitoring protocols.
molecules.gmp_methodologies: Cleanroom: ISO 5 / Class 100 fill-finish suite. Process: Redundant 0.22 µm filtration, low pH virus inactivation, depyrogenation tunnel (>250°C). Cleaning/CCIT: HBEL/PDE limits; 100% HVLD vial integrity testing; DSCSA track & trace.

molecules.formulation_class: Small Molecule (3rd-gen EGFR TKI; mesylate salt)
molecules.thicket_strategy: Crystalline mesylate salt form claims, adjuvant EGFR+ NSCLC indications, mutation subgroup treatment methods (T790M/L858R).
molecules.compendial_standards: USP Monograph, Ph. Eur. 2.9.3, JP 6.06, IP 2026
molecules.scientific_context: HPAPI containment (OEB 4/5), solid-state XRPD/DSC, companion diagnostic PCR/NGS testing for EGFR mutation status.
molecules.gmp_methodologies: Containment: OEB 5 (OEL < 0.1 µg/m³), negative pressure, split butterfly valves. Process: In-line NIR for polymorph stability during wet granulation. Cleaning/CCIT: UPLC-MS/MS cleaning swab validation; Blister seal integrity testing.

molecules.thicket_strategy: Dual checkpoint combination patents with Imjudo (tremelimumab), layered indication claims across SCLC, uHCC, and biliary tract cancers.
molecules.compendial_standards: USP <129>, Ph. Eur. 2031, JP General, IP Bio
molecules.scientific_context: Fc-triple mutation engineering (silencing ADCC/CDC), large-scale mammalian bioreactors, TFF ultrafiltration/diafiltration.
molecules.gmp_methodologies: Cleanroom: Grade A isolator on automated vial line. Process: Dual 0.22 µm filtration with pre/post bubble point testing. Cleaning/CCIT: TOC swab recovery on stainless steel bioreactors; Vacuum Decay CCIT (USP <1207>).

molecules.loe_horizon: Primary LOE: September 2031; Thicket Horizon: September 2031
molecules.thicket_strategy: Single PTE-extended core patent, polymorph and salt claims, global family filings covering 45+ jurisdictions.
molecules.compendial_standards: USP Monograph, Ph. Eur. 2.2.46, JP 2.01, IP 2026
molecules.scientific_context: Organic chemical synthesis, particle size micronization (USP <429>), continuous dosing regimen, hepatic/hematologic lab monitoring.
molecules.gmp_methodologies: Containment: OEB 4 (OEL 1–10 µg/m³). Process: Roller compaction / dry granulation; closed powder handling. Cleaning/CCIT: RP-HPLC swab testing based on HBEL/PDE limits; automated tablet friability/hardness testing.

molecules.thicket_strategy: Dense 24+ patent web: succinate salt forms, high-load tablet strengths, pediatric extensions, combination treatment methods with endocrine therapies.
molecules.compendial_standards: USP Monograph, Ph. Eur. 2.9.40, JP 6.02, IP 2026
molecules.scientific_context: High-drug-load tablet compression, salt stability control, intermittent 21/7 dosing schedule, mandatory baseline/periodic QTc ECG monitoring.
molecules.gmp_methodologies: Containment: OEB 4 suite. Process: High-shear wet granulation, fluid-bed drying with bed temp/moisture monitoring (USP <921>). Cleaning/CCIT: Ion chromatography swab testing (< 1 µg/cm²); At-line XRPD polymorphic control.

molecules.form: Solid Capsule (Hard gelatin) & Solid Tablet (Film-coated, oral)
molecules.loe_horizon: Primary LOE: March 2027; Thicket Horizon: March 2027
molecules.thicket_strategy: Capsule-to-tablet formulation switch (solid dispersion removing food effect), polymorph claims, Paragraph IV litigation settlement agreements.
molecules.compendial_standards: USP Monograph, Ph. Eur. 2.9.3, JP 6.06, IP 2026
molecules.scientific_context: Hot-melt extrusion for solid dispersions, overcoming pH-dependent solubility, 21/7 intermittent cycle, ANC neutropenia monitoring.
molecules.gmp_methodologies: Containment: OEB 4 suite. Process: Hot-Melt Extrusion (HME) / spray drying for amorphous solid dispersion. Cleaning/CCIT: Automated CIP cycles; Al-Al blister moisture barrier with 100% vision system integrity check.
